hypotheses.text: If Ruben Saldo (CB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, his increased pressure and blocking angle would have materially reduced Kai’s chance to score by limiting shooting space and sightlines.
If Noah Fairley (RB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, his nearer cover would have either forced a more hurried/angled shot or made a tackle possible, lowering the chance to score.
